title: Global Reforestation & Rewilding Tracker Update — May 6, 2026
summary: Antoine Moses set a Guinness World Record on May 1, 2026, planting 47,460 mangrove propagules in 24 hours at Tudor Creek, Mombasa, under Kenya's 15 Billion Tree Growing Programme — the culmination of the previously announced 24-hour restoration drive. Panama's Ministry of Environment launched its 2026 national reforestation program on May 4, targeting restoration of 1,000+ hectares of degraded land across critical watersheds. In Tonga, a UNDP-backed community initiative funded with USD 570,000 is pursuing 200,000 mangroves across Tongatapu and Vava'u, reaching 20 schools and 10 vulnerable coastal communities. Minnesota's St. Louis County also began post-fire reforestation at the Munger Shaw site, planting 40,000 pine seedlings as the first phase of a 350,000-seedling 2026 campaign.
